events.title: Emperor Caligula assassinated by his guards
events.description: Praetorian officers led by Cassius Chaerea stabbed Caligula in a palace corridor during the Palatine games. The Guard then made his uncle Claudius emperor.
events.html: Praetorian officers led by Cassius Chaerea stabbed Caligula in a palace corridor during the Palatine games. The Guard then made his uncle Claudius emperor.

events.title: Gold found at Sutter's Mill sparks the California Gold Rush
events.description: James Marshall spotted flakes of gold in the tailrace of a sawmill at Coloma. Within a few years some 300,000 people had flooded into California, which became a state in 1850.
events.html: James Marshall spotted flakes of gold in the tailrace of a sawmill at Coloma. Within a few years some 300,000 people had flooded into California, which became a state in 1850.

events.title: Baden-Powell publishes 'Scouting for Boys'
events.description: The first instalment of Robert Baden-Powell's handbook on outdoor skills and citizenship appeared in London. Boys began forming patrols of their own, and the Scout movement spread worldwide.
events.html: The first instalment of Robert Baden-Powell's handbook on outdoor skills and citizenship appeared in London. Boys began forming patrols of their own, and the Scout movement spread worldwide.

events.title: British battlecruisers defeat a German squadron at Dogger Bank
events.description: Forewarned by codebreakers, Admiral Beatty's battlecruisers intercepted a German raiding force in the North Sea and sank the armoured cruiser Blücher. Signalling errors let the rest escape.
events.html: Forewarned by codebreakers, Admiral Beatty's battlecruisers intercepted a German raiding force in the North Sea and sank the armoured cruiser Blücher. Signalling errors let the rest escape.

events.title: Sir Winston Churchill dies aged 90
events.description: Britain's wartime Prime Minister died in London, seventy years to the day after his father. He received a state funeral, the first for a politician since Gladstone.
events.html: Britain's wartime Prime Minister died in London, seventy years to the day after his father. He received a state funeral, the first for a politician since Gladstone.

events.title: Apple Macintosh goes on sale
events.description: Apple's Macintosh brought the mouse and graphical interface to an affordable personal computer. Launched with a famous television advert, it shaped the design of computers for decades.
